# M8 associated-alpha Squeeze fixture

`alpha-premultiplied.jxl` is the unchanged CC0 `alpha_premultiplied/input.jxl`
from the pinned JPEG XL conformance corpus. The corpus revision and archive hash
remain in `benchmark/jpegxl/production-program/corpora/conformance.json`.

Input SHA-256: `5028e630dc358bf4031cbf06e8a80f2bfbfa21fd0d088af74d83b473d3dd540a`.
It exercises a Level 10 global Squeeze transform with grouped premultiplied
alpha. The tracked copy keeps the M9 integration gate hermetic in a clean
checkout.
